notes: The case test_hicQuickQC.py covers: the first 1,000 accepted pairs of the small_test BAMs against DpnII. The Python test compares QC.log alone, skips the File line and stops at the shorter file; here QC.log and the five tables hicPrepareQCreport derives from it are compared byte for byte, with only the NamedTemporaryFile basename normalised (quickqc_temporary_matrix in comparators/text.py). Budget per the hicBuildMatrix formula 2*nnz_out*12 + threads*64 MB + C with nnz_out = 0, because a test run never fills the pixel list, and threads = 2, because hicQuickQC passes --threads 1 and buildMatrixMethods.py:889 raises it to 2. hicQC.html is compared after the named normalisations quickqc_temporary_name and pandas_styler_uuid. The five QC charts are drawn as well but not compared: their legends name the row after the random temporary matrix, and savefig(bbox_inches='tight') sizes each figure to that text, so the width changes from run to run of the same tool (measured 2026-09-14: the C++ determinism rerun of these cases differs by up to 21 pixels, as the Python runs differ from each other).
